description: This file contains validation logic for Kubernetes API schemas, including structural validation, extension checks, and value validation functions within the Kubernetes API extension server project.

classes.name: ValidationOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for schema validation, controlling nested property validation behaviors.

classes.name: level
classes.description: Enumeration representing schema validation levels: root, item, or field.

methods.name: ValidateStructural
methods.description: Performs structural validation on a schema with default options.

methods.name: ValidateStructuralWithOptions
methods.description: Performs structural validation on a schema with specified validation options.

methods.name: validateStructuralInvariants
methods.description: Checks schema invariants such as required fields and structural correctness.

methods.name: validateStructuralCompleteness
methods.description: Validates that the schema is complete and consistent (not shown in code but called).

methods.name: validateExtensions
methods.description: Checks Kubernetes-specific schema extensions for correctness.

methods.name: validateValueValidation
methods.description: Validates value validation rules within schemas.

methods.name: validateNestedValueValidation
methods.description: Validates nested value validation rules under logical operators.

methods.name: isIntOrStringAnyOfPattern
methods.description: Checks if schema matches the IntOrString 'anyOf' pattern.

methods.name: isIntOrStringAllOfPattern
methods.description: Checks if schema matches the IntOrString 'allOf' pattern.
